Krishna Kumar

Senior Investment Operations & Securities Valuation Professional Coimbatore, India 641 048 • +91 9344281365 kkrishnakumar10111997@gmail.com LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/krishna-kumar1 0

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Results-driven investment operations and securities valuation professional with 8+ years of experience, including 5+ years at State Street, one of the world's leading custodian banks. Sole Point of Contact (SPOC) for 2 major institutional clients, managing end-to-end securities operations across 500+ daily securities exceptions, ensuring zero SLA breaches and full compliance with audit controls. Deep expertise in securities pricing, portfolio valuation, NAV calculation, corporate actions, and OTC derivatives across multi-asset portfolios. Adept at leveraging Bloomberg, ICE, Reuters, and JPM systems to drive data accuracy, reduce exception resolution time, and deliver operational excellence. MBA-Finance graduate with strong cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder communication skills.

KEY ACHIEVEMENTS

Designated SPOC for 2 major institutional clients at State Street, managing full lifecycle of investment operations and serving as the primary escalation point for all client queries and exceptions.

Resolved 500+ daily securities exceptions across multi-asset portfolios, maintaining 1 00% SLA adherence and zero critical escalations through proactive root cause analysis and vendor coordination.

Reduced pricing exception resolution time by 20% by optimising cross-vendor workflows across Bloomberg, ICE, and Reuters through systematic process improvements and proactive broker outreach.

Contributed to process automation initiatives that reduced manual operational effort by an estimated 30%, improving team throughput and reporting accuracy across fund accounting workflows.

Trained and onboarded multiple new team members on securities operations, fund accounting procedures, and audit controls — ensuring consistent service quality and knowledge continuity.

CORE COMPETENCIES Investment Operations: Securities Valuation, Trade Validation, Custody Operations, Settlement, Corporate Actions Fund Accounting: NAV Calculation, FX Rate Computation, Amortized Cost Validation, Fund Record Maintenance Instruments: Equities, Fixed Income, ETFs, Mutual Funds, OTC Derivatives, Futures, Options Financial Databases: Bloomberg (BBG), ICE, Reuters, JPM Systems, S&P (Markit), myStateStreet, SQL Risk & Controls: Audit Compliance, Tolerance Break Analysis, Reconciliation, SOP Management, Anti-Fraud Controls Soft Skills: Client Relationship Management, SPOC Accountability, Stakeholder Communication, Team Training

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Senior Associate – Investment Operations & Portfolio Valuation | State Street August2020–Present • Coimbatore, India

Conduct cross-vendor price benchmarking across Bloomberg, ICE, Reuters, and JPM; analyse tolerance breaks, identify root causes, and coordinate upstream/downstream resolution — reducing exception resolution time by 20%.

Manually price OTC derivative instruments; analyse derivative positions and validate against system parameters to ensure portfolio valuation accuracy and compliance with prescribed controls.

Perform daily trade validations including security contributions, withdrawals, income postings, and tax-free exchanges; reconcile positions between internal record-keeping and portfolio systems, resolving all breaks within SLA.

Generate and distribute comprehensive client reports covering stale prices, suspended securities, tolerance failures, missing prices, matured, and halted securities — maintaining full transparency with institutional clients.

Ensure compliance with audit controls; maintain and update Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs); collaborate with Fund Services, Portfolio Management, Oversight Teams, and Technology to maintain data integrity.

Contribute to process automation initiatives, reducing manual effort by ~30% and significantly improving operational efficiency and reporting accuracy across fund accounting workflows.

sections.label: Summary
sections.text:
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Results-driven investment operations and securities valuation professional with 8+ years of experience, including 5+ years at State Street, one of the world's leading custodian banks. Sole Point of Contact (SPOC) for 2 major institutional clients, managing end-to-end securities operations across 500+ daily securities exceptions, ensuring zero SLA breaches and full compliance with audit controls. Deep expertise in securities pricing, portfolio valuation, NAV calculation, corporate actions, and OTC derivatives across multi-asset portfolios. Adept at leveraging Bloomberg, ICE, Reuters, and JPM systems to drive data accuracy, reduce exception resolution time, and deliver operational excellence. MBA-Finance graduate with strong cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder communication skills.
KEY ACHIEVEMENTS
Designated SPOC for 2 major institutional clients at State Street, managing full lifecycle of investment operations and serving as the primary escalation point for all client queries and exceptions.
Resolved 500+ daily securities exceptions across multi-asset portfolios, maintaining 1 00% SLA adherence and zero critical escalations through proactive root cause analysis and vendor coordination.
Reduced pricing exception resolution time by 20% by optimising cross-vendor workflows across Bloomberg, ICE, and Reuters through systematic process improvements and proactive broker outreach.
Contributed to process automation initiatives that reduced manual operational effort by an estimated 30%, improving team throughput and reporting accuracy across fund accounting workflows.
Trained and onboarded multiple new team members on securities operations, fund accounting procedures, and audit controls — ensuring consistent service quality and knowledge continuity.

Perform daily securities valuation and pricing across Equities, Bonds, Mutual Funds, ETFs, Options, Futures, and OTC derivatives, ensuring 1 00% SLA adherence and pricing accuracy across all client portfolios. • Manage Corporate Actions (dividends, stock splits, mergers, acquisitions, rights issues, spin-offs) for client portfolios, ensuring timely processing, accurate securities record updates, and correct client impact assessment.
Support fund accounting operations including FX rate calculation, amortized cost validation, and NAV
computation for mutual funds and hedge funds across multi-currency, multi-asset structures.
Conduct cross-vendor price benchmarking across Bloomberg, ICE, Reuters, and JPM; analyse tolerance breaks, identify root causes, and coordinate upstream/downstream resolution — reducing exception resolution time by 20%.
Manually price OTC derivative instruments; analyse derivative positions and validate against system parameters to ensure portfolio valuation accuracy and compliance with prescribed controls.
Perform daily trade validations including security contributions, withdrawals, income postings, and tax-free exchanges; reconcile positions between internal record-keeping and portfolio systems, resolving all breaks within SLA.
Generate and distribute comprehensive client reports covering stale prices, suspended securities, tolerance failures, missing prices, matured, and halted securities — maintaining full transparency with institutional clients.
Ensure compliance with audit controls; maintain and update Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs); collaborate with Fund Services, Portfolio Management, Oversight Teams, and Technology to maintain data integrity.
Contribute to process automation initiatives, reducing manual effort by ~30% and significantly improving operational efficiency and reporting accuracy across fund accounting workflows.
